relations.subject: Leonard Joseph Swidler
relations.role: Professor of Catholic Thought and Interreligious Dialogue
relations.evidence: Leonard Joseph Swidler (January 6, 1929 – March 23, 2026) was an American academic who was Professor of Catholic Thought and Interreligious Dialogue at Temple University, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, where he taught from 1966 to 2022.
